about.title: What is Aeroliths?
about.p1: Aeroliths is a free fan-made online strategy board game inspired by Skylanders Skystones. Two players face off on a tactical grid, taking turns to place elemental Lithos and capture their opponent's pieces. Each Lithos has its own attack values on four sides, and the player who controls the most stones at the end of the match wins.
about.p2: Build a deck that fits your playstyle, learn the strengths and weaknesses of the four elements (Fire, Water, Earth and Air), and climb the ranked leaderboard against players from around the world. The game runs entirely in your browser - no download required.
